items.title: Chainalysis says breach exposed password hashes and live tokens
items.summary: Chainalysis disclosed password hashes and live tokens were exposed after initially reporting only non-sensitive customer data was accessed.

items.title: IREN Mining Revenue Falls 58% as AI Sales Reach $200 Million
items.summary: IREN aims to substantially complete its mining transition by December, while its $4 billion AI revenue run-rate target moves into early 2027.

items.title: Zcash’s landmark NU7 upgrade goes live, speeding up private payments
items.summary: NU7 cuts the target time between blocks to 25 seconds, reduces the work wallets must do to find private payments and sets aside fees for future miners.

items.title: IREN’s bitcoin mining revenue drops 58% as firm plans full exit by year-end
items.summary: IREN has been shifting its focus to the AI infrastructure business, and its AI cloud revenue rose 182% in the past quarter to $200 million.
